senses.gloss: m. (חָלַק, v. חָלָק) plain, smooth garment, in gen. undershirt.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 28:9">Kel. XXVIII, 9</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00430"><he>חוּץ</he> II</cite>.—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 14a:8">M. Kat. 14ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>כל … אלא ח׳ אחד</he> he who has only one shirt.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 34a:5">Ab. Zar. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ לבן</he> a plain white frock, v. <cite ref="A01351"><he>אִימְּרָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:7:2">Y. Taan. II, 65ᵈ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Samuel 7:6">I Sam. VII, 6</cite>) <he>לבש שמואל חֲלוּקָן וכ׳</he> Samuel put on the common shirt of all Israelites, i.e. included himself among the sinners; a. fr.—Trnsf.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 19:2">Sabb. XIX, 2</cite> (drawn over the circumcised membrum).—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:1:17">Y. Pes. I, 27ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מפשיטו ח׳ אחד</he> he strips it of one shirt, i.e. removes one row all around the pile of bottles.—Pl. <he>חֲלוּקִים</he>, <he>חֲלוּקִין</he>, <he>חֲלוּקוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 22b:12">M. Kat. 22ᵇ</cite>. Y. l. c. <he>שני חלקות</he> (read: <he>חלוק׳</he>) two rows.

<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 5:6">Tosef. Kil. V, 6</cite> <he>שני ח׳</he> two shirts of different materials (<cite ref="K00674"><he>כִּלְאַיִם</he></cite>). Lam. R. introd. (R. Abbahu 2); <cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 5:6">ib.</cite> to III, 13 <he>והח׳ שלו עליו</he> (the camel) with his covers on; a. fr.
senses.label: b
